Our Eagle Creek is sensible enough not to mess with a good thing, but it does include a few thoughtful improvements to the traditional wear experience: we've swapped the sometimes stuffy oxford cloth of old for a tightly woven, sanforized cotton fabric that will retain its shape and size, and we've pre-broken the garment with a vigorous sand wash to give it our signature weathered hand.
